description: Runs a Recovery Probe command that has no dedicated tool, such as check and discover for an Electron app or an attached browser, action, observe (with --steps, --network or --files), refresh, reads, windows, android --list or doctor (setup checks), and returns its exit code and output. Commands: check, discover, action, reads, windows, observe, refresh, android, doctor. Pass --json where the command supports it. See the package docs for each command's configuration.
name: run_recovery_probe
title: Run a Recovery Probe command
